ruling.recommended_action: Route to RydeHELP human review for dangerous-driving allegation; preserve GPS trace and chat log; note rider's 995 / driver commercial-insurance / RydeHELP reporting paths; no fare action pending review.
ruling.escalation_reason: Safety dispute: rider alleges speeding, hard braking and shoulder overtaking, causing fear for personal safety. No automated disposition applies (SAFE-2). Fact summary: RydeX Jurong East MRT → NUS, pickup 21:22, drop-off 21:34; actual 8.5 km vs 8.6 km optimal (-0.1 km, -1%) [F1]; duration 12.8 min vs 14 min estimate (-1.0 min) [F2]; pre-pickup chats only confirm meeting point and vehicle [F3][F4]; driver denies any complaint and says rider was on the phone [F5]; both parties have clean 90-day dispute records [F6][F7]. Route/fare data neither corroborates nor refutes the driving-behaviour allegation; GPS trace should be pulled for acceleration/speed analysis. Human reviewer to contact rider, obtain details/timestamps of the incidents, and advise 995 (medical), driver's commercial motor insurance claim route, and RydeHELP reporting if further action is needed.
